MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

3. Solve for x: x + 9 = 21. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 9

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

5. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 12

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 41
   C. 49
   D. 31

8. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

11. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

12. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 20
   D. 21

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 169
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 13² = 13 × 13
3. 13² = 169
Final Answer: 169
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. B — 12
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 21 − 9
3. x = 12
Final Answer: x = 12
